Definition: Species name as printed in the supplement (underscored)

Structure: Mass of adult (or age unspecified) live or freshly-killed specimens (excluding pregnant females); captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: g.

Mass of adult (or age unspecified) live or freshly-killed, or museum specimen brains; captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; includes all types of fixation; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: g.

Note: Not a named variable in Table S2. S2 defines 'Neonate body mass' (mass of near-term/newborn specimens, up to 7 days old, g) but not a neonate *brain* weight specifically; do not assume the body-mass definition applies to this brain-weight column.

Structure: Neocortex – cc: volume of neocortex minus the volume of the corpus callosum. Unit per S2: mm3.
Note: Resolves prior ambiguity: this is neocortex EXCLUDING corpus callosum, not raw neocortex volume.
actual_source: Stephan collection lineage (Stephan et al. 1981 best fit; also Frahm 1982, Sherwood 2003, deSousa 2010, Stephan 1970, Heldstab 2016)
actual_source_citation: Frahm HD, Stephan H, Stephan M (1982) Comparison of brain structure volumes in Insectivora and Primates. I. Neocortex. J Hirnforsch 23:375-389 | Stephan H, Frahm H, Baron G (1981) New and revised data on volumes of brain structures in insectivores and primates. Folia Primatol 35:1-29
actual_source_evidence: Full sweep of every neocortex-volume column in the repo, both scales: 29 of 33 values match a Stephan-lineage table exactly (Stephan 1981 20/33; 21 species match 2+ tables). Bush & Allman publish only separate grey/white columns; tested as explicit sums they report 13 of the 33 species and match none of them (median rel. diff 0.165), and have no value for the other 20. External Database S1 cites ref (17) Bush & Allman 2003 on 23 of 25 neocortex rows -- a mis-citation. See Lewitus_etal_2014_Neocortex_source_attribution.csv.

Structure: Gyrification index (GI): a measure of the folding of the cortex; calculated from coronal sections of whole brain of adult (or age unspecified) of captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; calculated as the ratio between the outer and the inner surface of the brain; different fixation and staining methods (after Zilles, 1989).

Note: Not defined in Table S2 — no glossary entry for a ventricle-volume variable.

Structure: Maximum adult age measured either through direct observation, capture-recapture estimates, projection from physical wear, or unspecified method; captive, wild, provisioned or unspecified populations; male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: years.

Definition: Age at first breeding F mnths
Structure: 'Age at first breeding (females)'. S2 gives only the label and unit (months, continuous) with no expanded prose definition.

Mapped to S2's 'Age at first birth': age at which females give birth to their first litter (eutherians), or their young attach to teats (metatherians) or hatch out (monotremes); non-captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: days.
Note: Column name differs from S2's printed label ('Age at first birth'); mapping inferred by unit (days) and by elimination against 'Age at first breeding (females)' (months), not asserted by S2 itself.

Structure: Age when females are first physically capable of reproducing, defined as either physically sexually mature, age at first mating or unspecified, age at first oestrus, or age at first pregnancy; captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: days.

Age when [sic, S2 prints 'females'] are first physically capable of reproducing, defined as either physically sexually mature, age at first mating or unspecified, age at first spermatogenesis, or age at testes descent; captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: days.
Note: S2's own prose for 'Male sexual maturity' says 'age when FEMALES are first physically capable...' — an apparent copy-paste artifact from the female-sexual-maturity entry in the source. Transcribed verbatim per house convention (never silently corrected); the spermatogenesis/testes-descent clause makes clear the intended subject is males.

Structure: Length of time of non-inactive fetal growth; captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Measured between specified start point (conception, fertilization, first observed copulation, implantation, laying, palpably pregnant, removal of pouch young, capture [except marsupials], or unspecified) and end point (birth, hatching, or unspecified). Unit per S2: days.

Number of offspring born per litter per female, counted before, at, or after birth; captive, wild, provisioned or unspecified populations; male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: No. of offspring.

Number of litters per female per year; non-captive, wild, provisioned or unspecified populations; male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: No. of litters.

Length of time between successive births of the same female(s) after a successful or unspecified litter; non-captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: days.

Age when primary nutritional dependency on the mother ends and independent foraging begins to make a major contribution to the offspring's energy requirements; measured as weaning/lactation length, nutritionally independent, first solid food, last observed nursing, age at first flight (bats only), age at pouch exit, or length of teat attachment (marsupials only), or unspecified definition; captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: days.

Mass of live or freshly-killed specimens of infants at near-term embryonic stage, birth, immediately after birth, or up to 7 days after birth; captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: g.

Mass of live or freshly-killed specimens of weanlings; captive, wild, provisioned or unspecified populations; male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: g.
Juvenility – primates: the interval between infancy (physical dependence of the infant on the mother) and the onset of puberty. Unit per S2: years.

Juvenility: the length of time between the weaning age and the age of first reproduction; calculated as the difference between the categories 'Age at first birth' and 'Weaning age'. Unit per S2: days.

Size of the area within which everyday activities of individuals or groups (of any type) are typically restricted, estimated by direct observation, radio telemetry, trapping, or unspecified methods, over any duration of time; non-captive populations; male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities.
Note: UNIT MISMATCH: S2 states the unit as km2; this column is headed '_ha' (hectares). Not silently converted/corrected here — check which unit the analysis CSV values actually carry before using.

Structure: The percent of fruit and seeds typically in a species' diet. Unit per S2: %.

Activity cycle of each species measured for non-captive populations; adult or age unspecified individuals, male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities.
Note: States per S2: (1) nocturnal only; (2) nocturnal/crepuscular, cathemeral, crepuscular or diurnal/crepuscular; (3) diurnal only.

Structure: Number of dietary categories eaten by each species, measured using any qualitative or quantitative dietary measure, over any period of time, using any assessment method; non-captive or non-provisioned populations; adult or age unspecified individuals, male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: No. of diet categories.
Note: Categories per S2: (1) vertebrate; (2) invertebrate; (3) fruit; (4) flowers/nectar/pollen; (5) leaves/branches/bark; (6) seeds; (7) grass; (8) roots/tubers.

Structure: Trophic level of each species measured using any qualitative or quantitative dietary measure, over any period of time, using any assessment method; non-captive or non-provisioned populations; adult or age unspecified individuals; male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities.
Note: States per S2: (1) herbivore; (2) omnivore; (3) carnivore.

Structure: Number of individuals, adults or definition unspecified, in a group that spends the majority of their time in a 24-hour cycle together; measured over any duration of time; non-captive populations; male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: No. of individuals.

Number of individuals, adults, or definition unspecified, in a group that spends the majority of their time in a 24-hour cycle together where there is some indication these individuals form a socially cohesive unit; measured over any duration of time; non-captive populations; male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: No. of individuals.

Total length from tip of nose to anus or base of tail of adult (or age unspecified) live, freshly-killed, or museum specimens; captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: mm.

Age at which both eyes are fully open after birth; captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: days.
Category describing the developmental stage of a neonate, based on whether the eyes are open or closed after birth; NA for monotremes and metatherians.

Definition: Basal metabolic rate (journal header typo "Basal_metaboic_rate" corrected)
Structure: Basal metabolic rate of adult (or age unspecified) individual(s); captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Measured when individual(s) were experiencing neither heat nor cold stress, resting and calm, and post-absorptive (not digesting or absorbing a meal). Unit per S2: mL(O2)/h.

Age at which young permanently leave the parent, parental group, social group, or any associated territories; non-captive, wild, non-provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: days.

Number of habitat layers used by each species, measured using any qualitative or quantitative time measure; non-captive populations; adult or age unspecified individuals, male, female or sex unspecified individuals; all measures of central tendency; all localities. Unit per S2: No. of habitat layers.
Note: Layers per S2: (1) above-ground dwelling; (2) aquatic; (3) fossorial; (4) ground dwelling.

Structure: Social system classified following Smuts et al. 1987.
Note: States per S2: (1) solitary; (2) monogamous; (3) multi-male; (4) harem.

Structure: Ratio of glia to neuron cells in adult visual cortex.

Definition: Neuronal density in neocortex (journal header typo "Neuronal_denisty" corrected)
Structure: Neuronal density, adult visual cortex. Unit per S2: cells per mm3.

Definition: Glial cell density (journal header typo "Glial_cell_denisty" corrected)
Structure: Glial cell density, adult visual cortex. Unit per S2: cells per mm3.
Calculated as the period between the onset of neurogenesis in the subplate and the end of neurogenesis in layers II/III. Unit per S2: days.
